name: RRSOS PCC Vehicle
description: Three buttons on the vehicle station's window (the terminal you open at the station): Spawn Rover puts a new rover, with no gear, on the station's spawn spot; Gear Min gives the rover at the station the first tier of each piece of rover gear it has none of; Gear Max leaves it with the top tier of every piece (other gear is deleted). No terminal command and no Commands mod needed.
